changelog: Aura AI v2.1.6 — Upstream AntiGem Voice Call Sync, Chat Scroll Smoothness & Aura Gallery Filter
Voice Call Upstream Sync: Clean port of upstream AntiGem voice calling architecture, protocols and preview components
Chat Feed Smooth Scrolling: Removed per-block touch gesture interceptors and guarded layout measurements to eliminate scroll lag and stutter
Aura-Only Image Gallery: Filtered gallery to strictly show Aura-generated images, excluding device photos and user-uploaded media
Restored Assistant Message Actions: Footer controls for copying, retry, and details seamlessly rendered below assistant responses
